_meta.source: Derived from the same live capture as funding-ticker.json (GET https://api-pub.bitfinex.com/v2/tickers?symbols=fUSD, recorded 2026-07-05), reshaped to the WS `fticker` channel wire format per docs.bitfinex.com/reference/ws-public-ticker: drop SYMBOL (channel-scoped), shift every field left by 1, drop FIRST_TRADE (REST-only — WS returns null and it isn't modeled here).
